Answer: C
Reason: The sequence shows initial bilateral diffuse alveolar infiltrates (Figure 1) that progress to more dense consolidation (Figure 3), followed by significant resolution/clearing by day 4 (Figure 4a/4b). This rapid onset and clearance pattern is characteristic of exercise-induced pulmonary haemorrhage (EIPH), distinguishing it from the slower resolution of pneumonia or persistent nature of chronic disease.
